paper.title_en: A Unified Model for the Gravitational Wave Background and Quasar Luminosity Functions
paper.abstract_en: The supermassive black hole mass function (BHMF) is a necessary ingredient in our understanding of how BHs grow and evolve with their host galaxies. Estimations of the BHMF based on observations of local BHs, quasars, and gravitational wave data yield inconsistent results, leading to large uncertainties in, e.g., BH accretion and seeding models. The nanohertz gravitational wave background (GWB) has been a powerful tool to provide constraints on the BHMF across cosmic time. We take posterior BHMFs that describe the GWB and fit them to bolometric quasar luminosity functions (QLF) across $0.2 \leq z \leq 6.2$ to constrain the Eddington ratio distribution function (ERDF). Compared to a fiducial BHMF, based on galaxy and a local black hole mass scaling relation, the BHMFs that match the GWB can reproduce the observed QLFs with lower Eddington fractions and without requiring significant super-Eddington accretion. We use a double power-law form of the ERDF and find that the fits using the GWB-inferred BHMF have systematically lower break-points and marginally steeper slopes in the high-Eddington fraction portion of the function. Furthermore, the best-fit QLFs using the GWB-inferred BHMFs provide better fits to the high-luminosity end of the QLF data than the fiducial model. For both models the ERDF shows significant redshift evolution of the break-point which reaches a maximum around $z \sim 2$. Overall, our prescription can produce realistic QLFs from BHMFs and our GWB-based model is consistent with electromagnetic and gravitational wave data sets.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）反演得到的超大质量黑洞质量函数与类星体光度函数联合拟合，约束爱丁顿比率分布函数，横跨宇宙学红移到 z~6.2，属于 PTA 与黑洞增长/吸积这一交叉方向，值得研究者点击阅读全文以核对其建模假设与拟合细节。
decision.title_zh: 一个统一描述引力波背景与类星体光度函数的模型
decision.abstract_zh: 超大质量黑洞质量函数（BHMF）是我们理解黑洞如何与其宿主星系共同增长和演化所必需的要素。基于对本地黑洞、类星体和引力波数据的观测所得到的 BHMF 估计结果并不一致，从而导致例如黑洞吸积和种子模型等方面存在很大的不确定性。纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）一直是能够在宇宙时间尺度上对 BHMF 施加约束的有力工具。我们采用能够描述 GWB 的后验 BHMF，并将其拟合到 $0.2 \leq z \leq 6.2$ 范围内的热辐射类星体光度函数（QLF），以约束爱丁顿比率分布函数（ERDF）。与基于星系和本地黑洞质量标度关系得到的基准 BHMF 相比，与 GWB 相符的 BHMF 能够以较低的爱丁顿比率再现观测到的 QLF，且不需要显著的超爱丁顿吸积。我们采用双幂律形式的 ERDF，并发现使用 GWB 推断的 BHMF 所做的拟合，在该函数高爱丁顿比率部分具有系统性更低的拐点和略微更陡的斜率。此外，使用 GWB 推断的 BHMF 得到的最佳拟合 QLF 对 QLF 数据的高光度端拟合得比基准模型更好。对于两个模型，ERDF 都显示出拐点的显著红移演化，该拐点在 $z \sim 2$ 附近达到最大值。总体而言，我们的方案能够由 BHMF 产生符合实际的 QLF，并且我们基于 GWB 的模型与电磁和引力波数据集均一致。
